svg.text: Test Environments for the Encoder Use-Case Graphs
Left: the escalation ladder (what each level CAN and CANNOT prove) · Right: per-use-case browser recipes · Complements TEST_PLAN Tiers 1–5
Escalation ladder (run bottom-up)
L4 — Browser use-case suites (nightly, TEST_PLAN Tier-4 lane)
real pages driving U1–U5 graphs + getStats/counters assertions
PROVES: end-to-end pipelines, encoder selection, adaptation behaviour,
zero-copy on the REAL compositor device, perf vs SW baseline
CANNOT: bisect codec bugs quickly (use L2 for that)
env: headless Weston on NVIDIA runner (xvfb.py --use-weston pattern)
L3 — Browser zero-copy gate: wayland_zero_copy_check.sh
launches chrome, drives an encode to Flush/Destroy, greps LAST
"input-path summary: zero-copy=N staging=M" (grep -a survives NUL)
PROVES: the seam — PASS iff zero-copy>0 && staging==0 (--allow-staging relaxes)
THE authoritative zero-copy proof — gtests structurally cannot do this
media/gpu/vulkan/test/wayland_zero_copy_check.sh (dev)
L2 — video_encode_accelerator_tests --implementation=vulkan (per-CL)
TEST_PLAN Tier-2 · doc: docs/media/gpu/video_encoder_test_usage.md
library-device path (SetAllowLibraryDeviceForTesting — TEST-ONLY; no
compositor VkDevice in a gtest process) · SKIPs w/o Vulkan encode HW
PROVES: codec correctness + PSNR gate Vulkan_EncodePsnr_H264Baseline
(--vulkan_psnr_floor, default 38 dB; measured 51.07 dB on A4000, CQP=26)
also: FlushAtEndOfStream, bitrate modes, R-1 backpressure behaviour
args.gn keeps use_vaapi=false so the factory has exactly one backend
L1 — media_unittests --gtest_filter=*Vulkan* (pre-submit, no GPU)
fake_vulkan_video_encoder_ext (scripted library fake) + test peer seams
30/30 green at dev tip: async-init deferral, Model-D fail-fast, queued
Encode+Flush across init, UnresolvableGpuFrameFailsCleanly, F7 sticky fallback
PROVES: state machine + counter plumbing
CANNOT: prove zero-copy (no GPU-service SharedImages in the process)
Per-use-case browser recipes (all at L3/L4)
U3 WebCodecs — available NOW (P0 regression harness)
page: w3c encode-decode-worker sample (codec/HW/latencyMode/SVC knobs,
built-in per-frame encode-delay via frame.timestamp) or minimal canvas page
verify: NO web API reports the impl used (w3c/webcodecs#604) → chrome://gpu
Encode rows + vmodule logs + zero-copy gate script are ground truth
assert: gate PASS · isConfigSupported(prefer-hardware).supported === true
U4 MediaRecorder — cheap E2E win (closes a TEST_PLAN gap)
MediaRecorder(stream, {mimeType:'video/mp4; codecs=avc1'}) over fake camera
exercises VBR + Flush() drain semantics that WebCodecs CQ mode does not
verify: chrome://media-internals encoder selection + zero-copy counters
assert: produced file demuxes + decodes (ffprobe/ffmpeg), PSNR vs source
sample: webrtc.github.io/samples getusermedia/record
U1 WebRTC loopback — target of P1
pages: pc1 (pc1/pc2 page globals → getStats()) · change-codecs (setCodec-
Preferences H.264/AV1) · extensions/svc (scalabilityMode; needs G-NEW-6)
NO simulcast sample upstream → fippo simulcast-playground
assert: encoderImplementation==="VulkanVideoEncodeAccelerator" ·
totalEncodeTime/framesEncoded < 33ms · qualityLimitationReason ∉ {cpu}
expected-FAIL until G-NEW-3: bitrate tracking of setParameters ramps
U2 screen share / U5 cast — target of P2 (strict staging==0)
getDisplayMedia + --auto-select-tab-capture-source-by-title feeding a loopback
PC (upstream getdisplaymedia sample only captures — combine w/ capture/video-pc)
U5: CastStreamingOfferHardwareFirst default-on; pin codec via
--cast-streaming-force-enable-hardware-h264; sink = openscreen cast_receiver
perf: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.encoder,encoder.stats.averageFps,
encoder.stats.averageLatency + pidstat GPU-process CPU% vs SW control run
Reproducible input for ALL recipes
--use-fake-device-for-media-stream (fps=60,device-count=2 params ok)
--use-file-for-fake-video-capture=/path/1080p.y4m (.mjpeg ok too)
--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream · --auto-accept-camera-and-microphone-capture
The browser-run flag set is THREE features, not one (renderer gate: content/renderer/render_thread_impl.cc:991 — unpatched on dev)
chrome --enable-features=AcceleratedVideoEncoder,Vulkan,VulkanVideoEncode --ozone-platform=wayland \
--enable-logging=stderr --vmodule='*vulkan_video_encode_accelerator*=1' [--ignore-gpu-blocklist]
AcceleratedVideoEncoder = Linux renderer gate (renamed from VaapiVideoEncoder at M131; NO chrome://flags UI) · Vulkan = Skia-on-Vulkan → creates the BYO compositor VkDevice
VulkanVideoEncode = backend selection in GpuVideoEncodeAcceleratorFactory · --use-angle=vulkan is WebGL-only, unrelated · Ozone "headless" platform is software-only — use Weston
